pull_request.head: codex/lar-stack-merge-prep
pull_request.body:
Prepares #142 → #143 → #144 for an ancestry-preserving stacked merge. All three are ready for review at unchanged source heads, and all six original exact-head hosted workflows pass. No PR has been merged.

Merge using merge commits. After each parent lands, retarget its child to main and recheck its head/checks. Merge this accounting draft after #144. The ordered runbook, exact hashes and check receipts are in `docs/maintenance/lar-stack-merge/`.

| PR | Unique completed work turns | Observed input | Observed output | Observed total |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| #142 | 8 | 28,010,497 | 149,038 | 28,159,535 |
| #143 | 7 | 61,115,742 | 200,140 | 61,315,882 |
| #144 | 19 | 140,231,445 | 519,112 | 140,750,557 |

All 34 original-work turn keys are disjoint. Three newly finalized coordinator turns add 114,598,575 observed tokens, each owned once by a dedicated per-PR follow-up session. Prior owners/counters are unchanged. Shared preparation overhead is separate: one completed review turn contributes 4,113,186 observed tokens; active coordinator usage is unavailable. Cached input/reasoning output are subsets. These are partial token observations, not monetary costs.

Independent SoftEng assessment at `0f893f85e17303a6a35d57e2768540e8ac946b85` closed with no actionable findings. It verified ownership/totals, exact-target ledgers, visible-record privacy/parent metadata, source heads/CI and merge-tree identities. No human approval or new scientific acceptance is claimed.

Project/session/inventory/interaction validation and token preview build pass. Selected visible records exclude reasoning, arbitrary arguments/results and private state. No physics, geometry, runtime source or scientific progress tracking changes; no simulation rerun. The standalone routing prototype retains its integrated-fit and canonical-cell boundary limitations.
